news_articles.title: Eneos said to be in final talks for Chevron's Asian assets, including in Malaysia
news_articles.snippet: (April 28): Tokyo-listed Eneos Holdings Inc is the last remaining bidder for some of Chevron Corp's Asian assets in a deal that might be valued at more than US$2 billion (RM7.9 billion), according to people familiar with the matter.

news_articles.title: NTPC Green Energy, Japan's ENEOS Sign MoU To Develop Green Hydrogen Value Chain
news_articles.snippet: NTPC Green Energy (NGEL), a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC, has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Japan's ENEOS Corporation to explore cooperation in the field of green hydrogen and its derivatives, including green methanol and other renewable-based chemicals.

news_articles.title: Eneos and Mitsubishi Chemical introduce plastic-to-oil recycling facility in Japan
news_articles.snippet: Eneos and Mitsubishi Corporation partnered with Neste and Suntory to develop PET resin made with Neste RE, a feedstock made from bio-based raw materials.

news_articles.title: ENEOS accelerates AI-driven development of new lubricants and cooling fluids
news_articles.snippet: ENEOS Corporation has announced its new collaboration with NVIDIA and Preferred Computational Chemistry Inc. (PFCC) to accelerate the AI-driven discovery and optimisation of new lubricants and immersion cooling fluids.

news_articles.title: C2X, ENEOS, Maersk invest $100 million in green methanol portfolio
news_articles.snippet: C2X, a green methanol developer, and ENEOS, a japanese energy company, have secured a $100 million investment from A.P. Moller holding, and A.P. Moller - Maersk.

news_articles.title: Chiyoda wins EPC contract for Eneos' liquid organic hydrogen carrier project
news_articles.snippet: Last December, Eneos announced plans for the AUD $200m ($129.9m) facility, which they anticipate to produce 680kg of hydrogen per day.

news_articles.title: Eneos, Mitsubishi partner to advance SAF production in Japan
news_articles.snippet: Japanese petroleum company Eneos has collaborated with Mitsubishi to conduct a front-end engineering design (FEED) to accelerate the study of a sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) production facility at the Eneos Wakayama plant in Arida City, Japan.

news_articles.title: Mitsubishi and ENEOS to advance SAF production in Japan
news_articles.snippet: Mitsubishi Corporation (MC) and ENEOS Corporation have partnered to conduct a Front End Engineering Design (FEED) study for the production of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) at the ENEOS Wakayama Plant in Arida City, Japan.

news_articles.title: XING and ENEOS for immersion cooling battery systems
news_articles.snippet: In the pursuit of global sustainability, ENEOS, Japan's energy giant, launches advanced immersion cooling fluids to optimize the thermal management of data center servers and battery systems.
